speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a chest skin lesion; can you tell me how long this spot has been there and if it has changed in size or color?

speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Basal Cell Carcinoma.

I have noted that this 63-year-old male has a lesion on his chest that has been present for two months, is increasing in size, and is asymptomatic, alongside a history of diabetes and hypercholesterolemia. To confirm the diagnosis, I will need to perform a biopsy on the lesion.
